S01.title: HarnessTax
S01.scope: 21 model/harness pairs; 30 sampled tasks per benchmark, three runs per task; September 1 direct-API price list. No subscription-quota experiment.

S02.title: Codex subscription usage
S02.scope: Smaller prompts, AGENTS.md and tool context can extend included usage. Billing units are not a universal token-to-quota conversion.

S03.title: Codex authentication
S03.scope: ChatGPT login and API-key billing are distinct. Verify actual login mode and disable paid spillover.

S04.title: Claude Code usage accounting
S04.scope: API-equivalent dollar estimates are not subscription charges. Shared usage and delayed counters complicate attribution.

S05.title: Claude Code credential boundaries
S05.scope: Use the user-authenticated unmodified Claude Code worker. Do not transfer Claude subscription tokens into a third-party provider implementation.

S06.title: Opus 5.5 launch
S06.scope: Mixed-effort vendor comparisons. Keep benchmark version, effort and fallback scope attached to each observation.

S07.title: Opus 5.5 model specification
S07.scope: Exact identity claude-opus-5-5. Always-on adaptive thinking and model/conversation-specific thinking-block constraints.

S08.title: Fable 5.1 model specification
S08.scope: Exact identity claude-fable-5-1; default high. Future Fable 5.5 activation is not established by this source.

S09.title: Claude Code effort control
S09.scope: Opus 5.5 defaults to medium, Fable 5.1 to high. Unsupported requests can clamp; effective settings require readback.

S10.title: GPT-6 Sol and Luna
S10.scope: Luna max DeepSWE v1.1 66.6%; this does not measure high-effort quota efficiency or architectural review quality.

S11.title: GPT-6 Luna specification
S11.scope: Platform supports more efforts than the owner allows. This project restricts Luna to low/high.

S12.title: GPT-6 Astra
S12.scope: General capability evidence, not a measurement that Astra high dominates every backend task.

S13.title: GPT-6 Pro in ChatGPT
S13.scope: Pro is a ChatGPT product experience powered by Astra. Product message limits differ from coding quota; detect model fallback.

S14.title: Claire Vo blind model workbench
S14.scope: Qualitative support for testing Opus 5.5 on B2B frontend and long-running work; mixed results across creative tasks. Not a controlled quota study.

S15.title: Lisa Peyton newsletter comparison
S15.scope: One authored marketing comparison favors Fable style in several sections. No software or frontend correctness inference.

S16.title: Artificial Analysis Opus 5.5
S16.scope: Published configuration is max with fallback. Do not transplant its aggregate result to medium/high or quota economics.

S17.title: CLM pinned implementation
S17.scope: Contrastive state/action embeddings; typed choice endpoint. Context/question uses prose; scores are conditional on candidate descriptions.

S18.title: Pi pinned extension API
S18.scope: Native model/thinking setters and lifecycle hooks exist. Effort can clamp; extension exceptions alone are not dispatch enforcement.

S19.title: Astra-Ares architecture
S19.scope: Native pre-generation checkpoint, 1/2/5/10 generation leases, applied-setting acknowledgment. Long-session compaction and actual savings need qualification.

S20.title: Reasoning changes within a conversation
S20.scope: Native configuration updates are not equivalent to editing the initial prompt. Cache preservation has endpoint and lifecycle constraints.

S21.title: Computer Use boundary
S21.scope: Current feature excludes automating ChatGPT itself. Keep manual Pro handoff; do not introduce a bypass.

OWNER.title: Owner model and workflow policy
OWNER.scope: Authorizes model alternatives, local CLM, subscription-only execution, two harness profiles and direct publication on main.

limits: No controlled local subscription-efficiency frontier has been measured.
New releases have sparse exact-version firsthand editorial evidence.
No backend/frontend universal winner is established.
Higher efforts on the owner-supplied chart are not mathematically dominated merely because they cost more.
S01 measured older model versions and must not be relabelled as Opus 5.5 or GPT-6 evidence.
